name: WordRotate
description: A phrase where one word swaps for the next in the same spot, cycling through a list. The slot is as wide as the longest word, so nothing around it jumps.

words.description: The words to cycle through, in order.

duration.description: Milliseconds each word stays before the next replaces it.

announce.description: Announces each new word politely to screen readers. Off by default: most rotating words are decoration.

label.description: Accessible name for the whole slot when announce is off. Defaults to all the words, joined with commas.

isPaused.description: Stops the animation and shows the finished text. Moving content that lasts more than five seconds should be stoppable.

requirements: Without announce, the slot has an accessible name listing all the words, and the visible word is hidden from assistive technology
With announce, the visible word sits in a polite live region and is read when it changes
Hidden sizing copies of the other words are invisible to everyone, so they are never read twice
Decoration only: the animated layers are hidden from assistive technology and never take focus
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), and can also be shown still with the rdm-still class or isPaused
In forced-colors (high contrast) mode the text is drawn in the system colours
Does not flash: nothing changes more than three times in a second (WCAG 2.3.1)
Optional: it is a separate component, so projects that do not add it carry none of its code
screenReader: Without announce: the list of all words, once
With announce: each new word, politely

use_when: A headline such as Built for teams, makers, studios where one word changes
Showing the range of things a product handles
avoid_when: Words that carry information people must not miss
anti_patterns: Turning announce on for a purely decorative swap, which interrupts reading
Putting a different meaning in each word and expecting every one to be noticed
